descricao_original: Intralobular ducts are surrounded by glandular parenchyma and are lined by a cuboidal or columnar epithelium. Interlobular ducts are lined by a stratified columnar epithelium and anastomose with each other to form the main duct(s) connecting to the epithelium onto which secretions are released. 200x
